kits.prompt:
Create ONE professional modular 3D architectural component reference sheet titled "PACK-PAL-WALL-L1 — Lower arcade wall kit". EXACTLY FOUR separate wall modules, in a 2-by-2 grid on warm-white studio background, even lighting and light contact shadows. Each panel contains ONE COMPLETE uncropped isolated wall section from full base to full coping, front three-quarter view with visible wall thickness, flat join ends and enough back surface to understand construction. All four same apparent wall height and material/trim datums. These are plug-together STRUCTURAL WALL sections derived from an existing princess-palace illustration. Rose/ivory veined marble, source gold edging and indigo/blue/lilac/pink glass. Use the existing LOWER ARCADE in the reference: ivory engaged slender columns, layered pointed arches, rose-marble spandrels with white rose/leaf relief, blue/lilac/pink glazed infill with gold leaf/star tracery, narrow ivory cornice and blue/gold floral parapet band. Solid thick glazed walls, not an open colonnade. Preserve arch proportions and add the missing complete marble base and back thickness. S01 three straight bays. S02 two bays meeting at a 30-degree wall turn. S03 three bays on a genuinely curved 45-degree wall arc. S04 one bay and an attached half-octagonal terminal/tower pier with a flat join side, no full tower.
Label exactly below each model:
PACK-PAL-WALL-L1-S01 — Straight three-bay arcade
PACK-PAL-WALL-L1-S02 — Angled two-bay return
PACK-PAL-WALL-L1-S03 — Curved three-bay wall
PACK-PAL-WALL-L1-S04 — Tower / end-pier junction
All end planes use matching wall-height datum 60 and thickness datum 6, with base/dado/cornice/parapet profiles continuing to the seam at matching heights. These are proposed design-grid dimensions; do not distort source arch proportions. Plain marble connection faces with no ornament projecting across seams. No industrial plugs or metal kit connectors. Include original window/decor appearance as installed guides, reusing the existing motifs rather than inventing new glass/carvings. Show complete physically thick walls, not flat murals, detached fragments or open column rows. Actual angular and curved wall construction where requested. The structural tower junction is only an attached partial pier, no full tower. Generous blank gaps around objects. No assembled palace, gardens, lawns, fountains, people, stairs, extra props or watermarks. Names below objects, no text on object surfaces. Exactly four models and no extra detached detail objects; captions must be legible.
